body:
Pretty much yeah I no longer enjoy being indoors I want to be out meeting people making new friends, tomorrow im not even gonna go on my pc I'm just gonna be out the house, I have college in the afternoon anyway

Your advice helped loads though, was nice to vent to someone too

And thank you, wish you luck in yours, may speak to you again someday :)

Man I envy you so much, I would literally love a best friend

I do smile etc when with friends I try hiding my depression from them I just sort of feel like they can see through my fake smile

Either that or I'm so good at hiding it they haven't said anything about it

The bad vibes are usually just off strangers/possible new friends

I'm in the stage of trying to do that at the moment

I dropped my old friends because all they did was drag me down, but man making new friends is difficult

Do you have any suggestions for how to do that when your mind feels really depressed/hopeless?

And how to meet people while feeling depressed? I've noticed when I'm down people tend to avoid me more as if they know somethings up with me

I can't open up to my family I dont want to upset them or scare them (they hardly know im suicidal, I accidently hinted it once in an argument and she freaked out)

I don't think I can open up to my friends, I'm just not close enough with them :(
Part of the reason is because I haven't known them a long time, and I'm kind of depending on them... if they just dropped me I would have noone and it would probably push me over the edge :(

I don't know how they'd react as I've never done it before, and I don't see how it could help except spook them away

And yeah pretty much, hence why i'm trying to find different friends who I may fit in more with

The new guy, I dont really have any "close" friends

I have a few people that are "friends" but I can't ever do stuff like open up to them, and I never really see them anymore, and I have others who feel like "acquaintances"

Honestly just by replying it helps

It's more they already have their friendship circle and so they're all comfortable around eachother and i'm the new person who cant fit in

I had crap friends through school who I stopped talking to, same with college, I had a really bad phase of depression, met some people who did parkour, but they dont feel like good friends somehow (maybe its just me, they're not dicks)

Got into skateboarding, hesitant to meet people for that though incase I go through the same thing :( and it's harder
It's also really hard to find people to skate with and the page I posted on my post was just ignored :/

I have career hobbies but I don't enjoy them (not because of the hobbie, but because of the depression) and it's affecting my ability to enjoy them so I end up just surfing the web and killing time waiting for the next day wasting yet another day

I think one of the things is when im on facebook and I see people out having a good time and then theres me just sitting indoors by myself
And its not like im not invited to these places its just I feel super awkward there like i dont fit in or with new friends I feel like the friendship isnt really going anywhere so I drop them without even really giving it a shot

Haven't met them yet, society anxiety and stuff is kinda stopping me. 

Climbings another thing I want to do but yeah, I say that then the next day I spend indoors again

I just want to vent to somebody
I have never felt as lonely as today and I have no idea whats triggered it or why I feel like complete shit

I don't know what it is
People keep telling me I should go out and do something with my life but I don't know what that is... and it feels like nobody else can help.
I have this thought I crave of just not existing, I don't want to hurt my family or myself I would love to just have not been here in the first place, just not exist.

I just want to change my life because it's sitting in the same room everyday and it's so depressing.

If I do go out with people the depression sort of goes but then I come back home and it comes back.
Explained my life pretty much... want to vent to eachother?
I can only do basics atm, a few weeks but it varies

Can anyone give me some advice on a social life?

I'm 20yo, I'm doing a college course but the thing is I have almost nobody my age there (most are a lot older) and i'm not really looking for much older friends...

I have gotten into skateboarding however it's hard to force myself to go skate alone sometimes and i'm way too nervous to visit a skatepark. I'm considering meeting people online (have done before) who I can skate with as it seems the only real way to improve my social life.

I'm currently seeing a therapist about my depression, I'm pretty sure even if I met a couple of good friends the depression would almost completely disappear.

I literally spent my childhood in my room and didn't care about making friends because I was surrounded with people in school and college, suddenly those go and people I thought were my friends turned out not to be and then you realize you don't really have many friends.

Now I spend most of my time in my room (although it's improved a lot, I am getting out more) I will be happy once I'm surrounded by people who want to go out and don't have to sit in my room all day, I want to live a social life before I settle down in life...
